slug: 2026-06-04 Equinix faces challenge to Cape Town data centres over environmental concerns

facts.fact: Reuters reports Equinix already operates a data centre site in Johannesburg, running on 100% renewable energy coverage; no opening date is given, so as_of is the article date (2026-06-04).

systems.system: Equinix Cape Town (two planned data centres, up to 160 MW)
